task_instance: A user who is unsure where to start invokes skill-router with a vague goal ('build an internal analytics dashboard, not sure where to start'); run the funnel interview and produce the skill's core deliverable: a structured recommendation with 1 primary + up to 2 secondary skills, the exact invoke syntax, and an offered ready-made prompt.
evidence: Read the skill doc at plugins/agentic-awesome-skills/skills/skill-router/SKILL.md. It is a conversational interview-and-recommendation skill whose deliverable is pure text (no code, binaries, or external services required). Since no live user answers in this session, a representative user goal plus plausible funnel answers were supplied as INPUT DATA in sample_interview.md (Q1=building, Q2=rough idea, Q3=Next.js/Python/Postgres, Q4=collaborative). Produced recommendation.md by following the skill's Step 1-4 procedure exactly: it contains the required Step 3 format (primary skill with Why and fenced invoke syntax, up to 2 'Also consider' secondaries), the Step 4 offered ready-made prompt, and honors the Constraints (most-upstream pick = @brainstorming for a rough idea; collaborative preference rules out @loki-mode; 1 primary + <=2 secondary). Verified the deliverable against the skill's own required output structure and against its 'Verify the recommendation' caveat (candidate names from the static table, invocation/installation to be confirmed against the live catalog at use time). Files produced: sample_interview.md, recommendation.md, result.json in the work directory. No code execution or binary output was needed; the runtime's text-only abilities fully cover this skill's core deliverable.
